integrity: All stated proofs and numerical checks are internally reconstructed; computations are illustrative, not independent verification or an infinite-dimensional certificate.
scientific_limitations: The analytic theorem concerns positive-leg coordinate-right simplices; the explicit second-order coefficient is along one-long-leg families, not all simplex degenerations. The global fullness inequality and existence of a congruent equal-short-leg degeneration appear in prior literature. Earlier unindexed formulae may overlap.
title: Exact minimum-solid-angle ordering and anisotropic sharpness profile for right simplices
